subject: FinLedger SIG & SOC2 VM evidence — cadence, attestations, and exception log
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@kpmg.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finledger.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG & SOC2 VM evidence request — FinLedger audit window

Hi Rafael,

As part of the FinLedger SIG intake for the upcoming audit window, we need a compact evidence packet covering your vulnerability management program. Specifically we are asking for: 

- Scan cadence documentation (internal schedule + retention windows)
- Proof of remediation for high/critical CVEs in the last 12 months (remediation date, owner, rollback plan)
- Exceptions/compensating controls for any CVE with extended remediation timelines (>90 days)
- A signed attestation (authorized security contact) confirming your SLA commitments for CVE triage and patching timelines

Please include any supporting artifacts (scan export CSVs, patch manifests, playbook excerpts). If you maintain a living spreadsheet or Doc on this, a link is fine. Our ideal delivery is by EOD 2026-02-24 to align with the audit schedule; if you anticipate delays please let us know the blocker.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Regards,
Claire Huang
Senior Auditor — KPMG InfoRisk

Attachments: request-checklist-SIG-VM-2026.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@kpmg.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG & SOC2 VM evidence request — FinLedger audit window

Claire —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the scan cadence doc and a remediation register that maps each high/critical finding to an owner and closure artifact. I am looping in Kimberly (Vuln Ops) and Monica (Infosec) who will assemble the artifacts.

Quick notes on scope and what we'll send by 02/24: 
- RL-Scan-Cadence-2025Q4.pdf — outlines internal scan types (authenticated static + dynamic + container image), cadence (daily/weekly/monthly), and retention policy.
- CVE-Remediation-Register-2025.csv — export of our CMDB-to-vuln-tracker joins mapping CVE -> ticket -> owner -> remediation date -> verification artifact.
- ExceptionLog.csv (if applicable) — documented compensating controls and approval timestamps for any tickets beyond the SLA window.

Kimberly / Monica: can you confirm the list of high/critical CVEs we will include for FinLedger and attach the patch manifests?

Rafael
VP, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, claire.huang@kpmg.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG & SOC2 VM evidence request — FinLedger audit window

On Wed, Feb 18, 2026 Claire Huang <claire.huang@kpmg.com> wrote:
> As part of the FinLedger SIG intake for the upcoming audit window, we need a compact evidence packet covering your vulnerability management program.

Claire / Rafael — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Summary below and links to secured Drive.

Summary of deliverables (attached / linked):
- RL-Scan-Cadence-2025Q4.pdf (attached) — schedule and retention matrix.
- CVE-Remediation-Register-2025.csv (attached) — filtered to FinLedger scope (public-facing and tenant isolation hosts). Columns: CVE, vuln_score, ticket_id, owner, first_reported, remediation_date, verification_link.
- ExceptionLog.csv — two entries: one third-party kernel backport (approved 2025-11-02) and one planned deferred patch for a legacy device (compensating IDS rule in place). Approval tickets and approvers included.
- Playbook excerpt (inline) showing triage SLA: 24h for critical, 72h for high, 30 days for medium.

Secure links: https://drive.redwood.example/finledger/vm-evidence/2026 (viewable by FinLedger + auditor).
Attestation: I can sign the standard SOC2 attestation form; Rafael — do you want the signed PDF returned, or should we place an electronic signature via DocuSign?

Attachments: RL-Scan-Cadence-2025Q4.pdf, CVE-Remediation-Register-2025.csv

Kimberly Park
Vulnerability Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@kpmg.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG & SOC2 VM evidence request — FinLedger audit window

Kimberly — 

Received, thank you. The artifacts look aligned with our checklist. Two quick follow-ups before we close the intake: 

1) For the ExceptionLog.csv entries, please include the compensating control evidence (IDS rule config snippet or third-party patch notes) as a short text file or screenshot.
2) For the attestation, DocuSign works best for our records. Can you start an envelope addressed to claire.huang@kpmg.com and security@finledger.com, and cc rafael.mendes@redwood.ai?

If we can get the two items above by EOD 2026-02-24 we should be all set. If not, please propose the earliest patch. Also proposing a 30-minute sync Thursday 02/26 09:00 PT if you prefer to review together.

Thanks again — Claire

--
Claire Huang
Senior Auditor — KPMG InfoRisk
